description: Microsoft Graph app role (GroupMember.ReadWrite.All / Group.ReadWrite.All) - add a member to a group, including role-eligible groups, from a service principal.
prerequisite_privilege: A service principal holding the GroupMember.ReadWrite.All app role
abuse_primitive: Graph POST /groups/{id}/members/$ref to add a principal you control to a privileged group.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add member to group' (directory logging default-on).
Defender for Cloud Apps can flag unusual group-membership changes by an app/service principal.

notes: Default-logged in the directory audit; alerting depends on MDCA/SIEM. The service-principal actor (vs a user) is itself a useful anomaly signal.
